note: Startup measured, spawn to tools/list reply. Warm median of 7: pipx 0.656s, (A) uvx 0.684s, (B) uv run 0.666s. Cold with an empty uv cache: A 3.58s, B 3.87s. On a cold start Claude Code shows the plugin server as `pending` in -p and that first session has no tools; warm starts connect. With no uv on PATH, A and B both show `failed` (ENOENT), the session runs without the tools, and nothing is shown to the user. Offline after install: B starts in every case. A fails once uv's cached index metadata is over 10 minutes old: about 5s with no network or a refused proxy, and 48s on a hanging network, which is past Claude's 30s connect timeout. Only UV_OFFLINE=1 lets A start. A plugin update with no network fails for both. Full table: scratchpad/US-PM-55-6-measurements.md
